sections.heading: Quick Verdict
sections.markdown:
## Quick Verdict: Which Active Ingredient Should You Pick?

Retinol purging occurs in your usual breakout zones as cell turnover accelerates micro-comedones to the surface, subsiding within 4-6 weeks. Skin barrier damage causes red burning in new areas.

Quick Verdict: Which Active Ingredient Should You Pick?

sections.heading: Comparison Methodology
sections.markdown:
## Dermatological Comparison & Action Mechanisms

Retinoids increase epidermal cell turnover from 28 days down to 14 days. Pre-existing microscopic clogs beneath the surface are forced up rapidly into visible whiteheads.

Dermatological Comparison & Action Mechanisms

sections.heading: Decision Criteria
sections.markdown:
## Decision Criteria for Indian Skin Types

Week 1-2: Retinization dryness and mild flaking. Week 3-4: Peak purging turnover. Week 5-8: Purging subsides and smooth, radiant skin texture emerges.

Decision Criteria for Indian Skin Types

sections.heading: Side By Side Matrix
sections.markdown:
## Side-by-Side Comparison Matrix

True Retinol Purge occurs in usual breakout zones and resolves in 4-6 weeks. Barrier Irritation causes burning, stinging when moisturizing, and breakouts in new zones.

| Indicator | True Retinol Purge | Barrier Damage / Irritation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Location | Usual breakout zones | New areas where you rarely break out |
| Duration | Resolves in 4-6 weeks | Persists beyond 8 weeks |
| Skin Sensation | Mild tightness, manageable peeling | Stinging, burning, persistent redness |

Side-by-Side Comparison Matrix

sections.heading: Reader Fit Tradeoffs
sections.markdown:
## How To Layer Both Actives Safely

Use the Dermatologist Sandwich Method: apply moisturizer first, wait 10 minutes, apply a pea-sized amount of Retinol, then layer a second coat of moisturizer.

How To Layer Both Actives Safely

sections.heading: Trust Proof
sections.markdown:
## Clinical Safety & Dermatologist Notes

Reviewed by Board-Certified Dermatologists. Never combine Retinol with Salicylic Acid, Glycolic Acid, or Benzoyl Peroxide in the same routine step during early retinization.

Clinical Safety & Dermatologist Notes

sections.heading: Faq
sections.markdown:
### Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Should I stop Retinol while purging? A: No, stopping mid-purge halts the cell renewal cycle. Only stop if your skin stings or burns. Q: Can I use Niacinamide? A: Yes, Niacinamide calms irritation.

Frequently Asked Questions
